GUARDS, decided per file rather than uniformly. Re-runnability: all three are idempotent and were applied THREE TIMES each with exit 0. The press CHECK is guarded on a pg_constraint existence lookup SCOPED to conrelid, which is a correction to the archived file's bare conname match; NOT VALID then VALIDATE keeps the lock off the table scan. The view uses CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW rather than the chain's drop-view-cascade idiom, so nothing is dropped, no CASCADE is needed and no grant is destroyed, and PostgreSQL itself refuses a replacement that would remove an existing output column (42P13, measured), so the 34 pre-existing columns cannot be silently lost. The two preference tables use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plus DROP POLICY IF EXISTS before each CREATE. NO EXISTENCE GUARD was wrapped around the view or the columns on purpose: a guard would trade a loud abort for a silently narrow result, which is the exact defect being closed, so those two preconditions are Layer 0 STOP CONDITIONS in the manifests instead.

FOUR DEFECTS IN THIS LANE'S OWN WORK WERE FOUND BY EXECUTING THE MIGRATIONS, and all four are recorded because the shape is reusable. (1) A header comment line lost its double-dash prefix, so the migration failed to parse at byte 91; no static gate in this repository checks that. (2) A post-condition row assertion sat after the constraint assertion, so its negative control fired on the wrong message and the assertion was never measured; the order is now data-first. (3) A post-condition asserted that WITH CHECK is null on every policy, which reports a HEALTHY FOR SELECT policy as a violation because a SELECT policy's WITH CHECK is structurally absent. That is the polqual and polwithcheck confusion DB-013 and DB-014 each reintroduced in this same repository, reintroduced here, and caught only by running the file. (4) An RLS assertion used EXISTS over a two-table IN list, so FORCE removed from exactly ONE table read GREEN; rewritten as a COUNT of 2 that names the offender. A FIFTH defect was in a CONTROL rather than in a migration: the first music_tracks negative control used CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW to restore a 34-column view, which PostgreSQL refuses, so the view was never changed and the gate read green against an untouched fixture. Each control now asserts its own post-state.

THE INBOUND HANDOFF'S COLUMN COUNT WAS WRONG AND IS CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT. HF-DISC-002-NEWSCHEMA-ACTIVE-CHAIN-GAPS records the live music_tracks projection as 36 columns; it has 34, measured by letting PostgreSQL 16.15 resolve the chain view's own SELECT list. The four trust columns bring it to 38. The post-condition asserts 38 and names all 34 pre-existing columns individually, so a count copied from the handoff would have reported every healthy target as broken.

A SIXTH GAP OF THE IDENTICAL CLASS WAS FOUND AND ROUTED, NOT ABSORBED: public.press_release_shares is created only by the archived 20260717221000, is absent from the chain AND the contract, and has live consumers. Its absence makes canAccessPressRelease return allowed false for every NON-owner, so the press-release share and PDF-download feature 403s for every shared recipient, and DB-019's press migration restores the columns that function reads, so it now gets FURTHER before returning false. Routed to the artist lane as HF-DB-019-PRESS-RELEASE-SHARES-CHAIN-SURFACE. No migration filename outside DB-019's literal three was created.

TWO DISCLOSURE-SHAPED PRESS FINDINGS ARE RECORDED, NOT FIXED, as HF-DB-019-PRESS-EMBARGO-AND-BOILERPLATE-READ-SCOPE to QA-003. (1) embargo_until is ADVISORY: the PDF route reads it to label the document and never compares it to now, and the only enforcement in the repository is a countdown string. Restoring the column restores the data contract and creates no control. (2) The policy Public can view published blog posts is USING status equals published OR auth uid equals user id, so anon already reads every published row, and boilerplate is the field most likely to hold pre-announcement text. To be precise about direction, this does not widen ROW visibility, because the rows were already readable; it adds a new KIND of data to an already-public surface. Narrowing it is the press and product decision and was not taken inside a schema-gap migration.
